conditions.transport: LAN direct to isolated local KonomiTV
conditions.playback: recorded MPEG-2 TS Original, true fullscreen, one page
conditions.material: verified Nogizaka Koujichuu segment on local SSD; MADDER only for the separately verified film segment

predecessorFullReset.branchStatus: deleted after successor publication to prevent accidental merge

oneShotMainThreadStall.interpretation: A one-shot wall-clock busy loop blocks both rAF and rVFC. It tests recovery but did not isolate queue-capacity handling in these runs.

scope.productionControlLogic: Exact 52a3db5 and 26484fd logic respectively. No one-field presentation policy or queue-control change.
scope.testOnly: Both builds add the same every-other-presentation hook and passive counters for FIFO retirement, presentation retirement, full reset, and pre-retirement oldest-field lateness.

capacityPressureEvidence.method: After explicitly starting YADIF double-rate, suppress only every other presentation for 2 seconds inside an 8-second sample. Retain rVFC input. Run three fresh pages per build.
capacityPressureEvidence.latenessDefinition: Maximum max(0, requestAnimationFrame timestamp - oldest queued field scheduled time), sampled before any retirement in #present().

excludedRuns.reason: The production predecessor and successor builds did not contain the global test hook, so setting the flag injected no presentation throttling. These are ordinary-playback observations, not forced-presentation evidence.
The user reported touching the device during this final run. It was excluded and replaced by f7-stall250-rerun under the same fullscreen LAN condition.

A first attempt had YADIF presentation stopped (draws=0 and outputFps=0). It was rejected before an output file was accepted. The rerun explicitly required Deinterlacer.running=true, doubleRate=true, and at least one canvas draw.

Preliminary A/B runs measured lateness only after retirement, which necessarily reported the displayed field as 0 ms late under the existing multi-field presentation policy. They were superseded by the documented pre-retirement oldest-field definition and are not included.

conclusion: The formal candidate directly reduced 90-seek stalls from 35/90 to 1/90. In the formal-control-logic pressure test, the candidate used no full reset and kept pre-retirement presentation lateness at or below 6.52 ms; the previous predecessor diagnostic comparison is no longer used as submitted-build evidence.

formalDirectComparison.method: 90 alternating seeks to 540 and 900 seconds; observe each for 1800 ms
